sourceEvent.text: I sent my stained-glass panel to the Tern Gallery. Curator Amira said the selection decision would come by October 18, 2026. I still do not know the decision.
李雯向栖云电台提交了自己的录音。她告诉我，电台会在 2026 年 11 月 4 日上午十点到十二点之间回复她；我还不知道结果。

sourceEvent.text: I asked the Larkspur observatory about the night-sky print. They said the answer would arrive on November 1, 2026; I have not heard back.
Someone at the Lantern workshop contacted someone about a kiln slot, but I do not know whose request it was or whether anyone replied.
